Name: Silver Plate
Description: A gleaming piece of tableware. Clean enough to eat off of.

Name: Worn Dagger
Description: A worn knife with a dull blade. Might be worth a few pennies.

Name: Hardtack
Description: A piece of survival food. Hard as a rock...

Name: Small Amber Gem
Description:
A brilliant gem.
If you look closely, you can see an insect trapped inside...

Name: Tattered Flag
Description: A rolled flag depicting the heraldry of a long dead knight.

Name: Whole Chicken
Description: How the heck did this get here?

Name: Silver Sword
Description:
A shining blade designed to slay werewolves.
Beautiful, but not magical.

Name: Ogre's Tooth
Description: You'd hate to meet whatever this came off of.

Name: Small Painting
Description: A small portrait of a petty noble. Smudged with fat fingerprints.

Name: Ivory Statuette
Description:
An intricately carved statuette in the shape of a dragon.
It seems to glow in the sunlight.

Name: Worg Paw
Description:
A trophy from a vicious beast.
There are bite marks on it.

Name: Fine Cutlery
Description: A set of fine silver cutlery.

Name: Bag of Chalk
Description:
Sticks of chalk in various colors.
The green chalk is missing.

Name: Tattered Poster
Description: A poster advertising a semi-famous opera singer.
